parts.question: German AX-17 guidance before latest revision?

result.answer:
The German AX-17 guidance before the latest revision (DE-AX17-LBL-042, effective 2026-09-15 [E4]) was the DE-AX17-LBL-038 Superseded Label v3.8 [E2, E3]. This guidance was effective from 03-Feb-2025 and was superseded on 15-Sep-2026 [E3].

According to this historical guidance, the renal dosing for AX-17 was:
*   Normal renal category: 50 mg OD [E2]
*   Mild renal category: 50 mg OD [E2]
*   Moderate renal category: 50 mg OD [E2], which was a historical fact and superseded [E2, E3]
*   Severe renal category: Not recommended [E2]
